subject: House of Skulltula
text: Visiting the Skulltula house after capturing 50 Gold Skulltulas rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Requirements: 50 Gold Skulltulas captured

How to get: Visit the Skulltula house after you get 50 Skulltula tokens, and
 you'll get this Piece.

subject: Frogs in Zora's River
text: Playing the Song of Storms for the frogs in Zora's River rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
How to get: Play the Song of Storms for the frogs in the river and they'll give
 you this Piece.

subject: Frog Fly-Catching Minigame
text: Completing the fly-catching minigame by playing corresponding Ocarina notes for the frogs in Zora's River awards a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Using the Ocarina, play notes corresponding to each frog 
 so that they can catch the flies above them...Finishing the minigame will 
 get you this Piece of Heart.

subject: Treasure Box Shop
text: Paying 10 Rupees at the Treasure Box Shop at night and using the Lens of Truth to find small keys opens the final chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Requirements: Lens of Truth, 10 Rupees...Enter the Treasure Box Shop during night...use the Lens of Truth to see which treasure
 chest holds the small key needed to continue. Keep doing this to reach the 
 end, which has a treasure chest containing this Piece.

subject: Magic Plant
text: Planting a Magic Bean near the Triforce stand in Death Mountain Crater as Young Link allows Adult Link to ride the Magic Plant to a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Enter Death Mountain Crater from Goron City, and head to the
 Triforce stand. You'll see a plot of dirt. Warp here as Young Link and quickly 
 plant the Magic Bean on it, and return here as Adult Link. Ride the Magic 
 Plant to this Piece.

subject: Ice Blade Room
text: In the Ice Cavern ice blade room, melting the east red ice wall and then the left block of red ice with Blue Fire reveals a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Grab some blue fire in the ending room of the Cavern, then melt the
 east red ice wall in the ice blade room. Inside, melt the left block of red
 ice to get this Piece.

subject: Northeastern Room
text: In Master Quest's Ice Cavern northeastern room, placing a bomb on the crystal switch tip through the icy floor makes the ice blocks disappear to reveal a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
In the northeastern room, look around the icy floors to find the 
 tip of a crystal switch poking through. Place a bomb there to activate it. 
 This will make the ice blocks containing the Piece of Heart to disappear, so 
 grab it.

subject: Zora's Fountain Underwater Floor
text: Sinking to the bottom of Zora's Fountain using the Iron Boots while wearing the Zora Tunic yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Equip the Zora Tunic so you won't drown, and use the Iron Boots to
 sink to the bottom. Find the Piece under there.

subject: Hyrule Field Secret Cave
text: Bombing the lone tree west of Hyrule Castle reveals a Secret Cave where sinking to the water bottom with Iron Boots yields a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
West of Hyrule Castle, plant a bomb at the lone tree where there's
 trees surrounded by a river. It'll open a Secret Cave. Head inside, and sink
 to the bottom of the water with the Iron Boots. The Piece is down here.

subject: Gerudo Fortress Roof Chest
text: At the very top of Gerudo Fortress, Link can Longshot directly to a giant treasure chest containing a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
At the very top of the fortress is a giant treasure chest. Get to
 a point where you can Longshot directly to the chest. Open this chest for this
 piece.

subject: Horseback Archery
text: Scoring 1000 points in the Horseback Archery minigame behind Gerudo Fortress while on Epona rewards Link with a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Behind the Fortress, through a long path, is a secluded area which
 is basically the Horseback Archery game. Talk to the Gerudo while on your
 horse and get 1000 points. You'll get this piece in return.

subject: Desert Colossus Arch
text: Planting a Magic Bean at Desert Colossus as Young Link and riding the plant as Adult Link allows Link to jump off at the arch for a Piece of Heart.

evidence.quote:
Go to the Desert Collosus as Young Link and plant a Magic Bean on
 the plot of dirt. Return as Adult Link and ride the plant, jumping off at the
 arch where this Piece is located.

subject: Lost Woods Target Practice
text: Scoring three perfect hits of 100 points each on the Lost Woods target with the Fairy Slingshot earns a bullet bag upgrade holding 40 Deku Seeds.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bullet bag made by the Deku Scrub who runs the
 Lost Woods target practice game. This holds 40 Deku Seeds; 10 more than what 
 you normally carry...Use the Fairy Slingshot to score three perfect hits on the target
 in Lost Woods (100 per hit).

subject: Business Deku Scrub
text: Deflecting a Deku Nut back at the Business Deku Scrub under the bridge in Lost Woods lets Link purchase an upgrade to carry 20 Deku Sticks for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 20 Deku Sticks instead of 10...A business Deku Scrub should be behind one of the pillars. Deflect 
 a Deku Nut back at him with the Deku Shield and he'll surrender. In return, 
 he'll give you the upgrade at a cost of 40 Rupees.

subject: Shooting Gallery
text: Shooting all Rupees with the Fairy Slingshot in the Hyrule Market Shooting Gallery awards a bullet bag upgrade holding 50 Deku Seeds.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bullet bag that can be won in Hyrule Market's
 Shooting Gallery if you already got the first upgrade. This holds 50 Deku 
 Seeds...In the Shooting Gallery, use the Fairy Slingshot to shoot all the
 Rupees in one game.

subject: Hot Rodder Goron
text: Stopping the Hot Rodder Goron with a Bomb under the enclosure in Goron City rewards a bomb bag upgrade allowing Link to carry 30 Bombs.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bomb bag that'll allow you to carry 30 Bombs...Head to Goron City, and stop the Hot Rodder Goron with a Bomb
 while under the enclosure. He'll give you this in return.

subject: Business Deku Scrub
text: In a Secret Cave revealed by bombing a boulder outside Sacred Forest Meadow, a Business Deku Scrub sells an upgrade to carry 30 Deku Nuts for 40 Rupees.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 30 Deku Nuts...After exiting the Sacred Forest Meadow, blast the boulder with a 
 Bomb to reveal a Secret Cave. Drop in to find two Business Deku Scrubs. One 
 will sell you this upgrade for 40 Rupees.

subject: Bombchu Bowling Alley
text: A bomb bag upgrade that lets Link carry 40 Bombs can be won as a random prize at the Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade is a bomb bag that lets you carry 40 Bombs...In Bombchu Bowling Alley in Hyrule Market, this is one of the
 random prizes you can win.

subject: Forest Stage
text: Talking to the leader of the Deku Scrubs at the Forest Stage in Lost Woods while wearing the Skull Mask rewards an upgrade to carry 30 Deku Sticks for free.

evidence.quote:
This upgrade allows you to carry 30 Deku Sticks...Get the Skull Mask from the Happy Mask Shop, then take it to the
 Forest Stage in Lost Woods...Talk to the leader of the Deku Scrubs here 
 while wearing the Skull Mask, and he'll give you this upgrade for free.
